clips.speaker: S1
clips.text: Harlow lent me money for my father's shop. After that, every conversation seemed to come back to what I owed him.
clips.key: S1|steady|Harlow lent me money for my father's shop. After that, every conversation seemed to come back to what I owed him.

clips.speaker: S2
clips.text: I managed the Harlow trust. Edmund supplied the name. I did the work. We did not always agree about what that was worth.
clips.key: S2|steady|I managed the Harlow trust. Edmund supplied the name. I did the work. We did not always agree about what that was worth.

clips.speaker: S3
clips.text: I'm a doctor. Harlow knew me professionally. I'd rather you asked me a precise question than made a dramatic assumption.
clips.key: S3|steady|I'm a doctor. Harlow knew me professionally. I'd rather you asked me a precise question than made a dramatic assumption.

clips.speaker: S4
clips.text: Jonah Pike. Art dealer. Harlow was a client. A very demanding client, as anyone who dealt with him could tell you.
clips.key: S4|steady|Jonah Pike. Art dealer. Harlow was a client. A very demanding client, as anyone who dealt with him could tell you.

clips.speaker: S1
clips.text: The lounge. Half past ten, yes. I know how this sounds, but that's where I was.
clips.key: S1|steady|The lounge. Half past ten, yes. I know how this sounds, but that's where I was.

clips.speaker: S1
clips.text: I was in the lounge when it happened. You don't have to like the answer, Detective.
clips.key: S1|steady|I was in the lounge when it happened. You don't have to like the answer, Detective.

clips.speaker: S1
clips.text: It was the hall. I took my debt note from Harlow's coat before half past ten. I was trying to get out from under that debt.
clips.key: S1|steady|It was the hall. I took my debt note from Harlow's coat before half past ten. I was trying to get out from under that debt.

clips.speaker: S2
clips.text: Tea, Detective. I was making tea in the kitchen. Surely that isn't so difficult to believe.
clips.key: S2|steady|Tea, Detective. I was making tea in the kitchen. Surely that isn't so difficult to believe.

clips.speaker: S2
clips.text: In the kitchen, making tea. Must an ordinary answer sound suspicious?
clips.key: S2|steady|In the kitchen, making tea. Must an ordinary answer sound suspicious?

clips.speaker: S2
clips.text: The kettle was boiling. I stayed beside it. That is where I was at half past ten.
clips.key: S2|steady|The kettle was boiling. I stayed beside it. That is where I was at half past ten.

clips.speaker: S2
clips.text: All right, I went into the study. But Edmund was already dead when I got there.
clips.key: S2|steady|All right, I went into the study. But Edmund was already dead when I got there.

clips.speaker: S2
clips.text: Edmund never spoke after I entered the study. There was no answer from him.
clips.key: S2|steady|Edmund never spoke after I entered the study. There was no answer from him.

clips.speaker: S2
clips.text: Edmund and I were in the study. The cable was in my hands. I can't make that sound any better.
clips.key: S2|steady|Edmund and I were in the study. The cable was in my hands. I can't make that sound any better.

clips.speaker: S2
clips.text: The cable was in my hands, in the study. I have nothing to add to that.
clips.key: S2|steady|The cable was in my hands, in the study. I have nothing to add to that.

clips.speaker: S3
clips.text: The conservatory. Half past ten, yes. That's my answer.
clips.key: S3|steady|The conservatory. Half past ten, yes. That's my answer.

clips.speaker: S3
clips.text: At that hour I was in the conservatory. I'm being quite precise.
clips.key: S3|steady|At that hour I was in the conservatory. I'm being quite precise.

clips.speaker: S3
clips.text: Yes, the kitchen. I borrowed the medicine without logging it. That's what I was afraid you'd find.
clips.key: S3|steady|Yes, the kitchen. I borrowed the medicine without logging it. That's what I was afraid you'd find.

clips.speaker: S4
clips.text: At that hour? The hall. I don't see what's so remarkable about that.
clips.key: S4|steady|At that hour? The hall. I don't see what's so remarkable about that.

clips.speaker: S4
clips.text: I was in the hall when it happened. Is there some reason that troubles you?
clips.key: S4|steady|I was in the hall when it happened. Is there some reason that troubles you?

clips.speaker: S4
clips.text: The conservatory, then. I brought a forged certificate. There. You have the disgraceful part of my evening.
clips.key: S4|steady|The conservatory, then. I brought a forged certificate. There. You have the disgraceful part of my evening.

clips.speaker: S3
clips.text: He answered her. Harlow answered Vale after she went into the study. I know what I heard.
clips.key: S3|steady|He answered her. Harlow answered Vale after she went into the study. I know what I heard.

clips.speaker: S4
clips.text: The trust accounts were forged. Harlow meant to expose Vale. Ask yourself what that meant for her.
clips.key: S4|steady|The trust accounts were forged. Harlow meant to expose Vale. Ask yourself what that meant for her.

clips.speaker: S3
clips.text: Imran? In the hall when it happened. I saw him there.
clips.key: S3|steady|Imran? In the hall when it happened. I saw him there.

clips.speaker: S4
clips.text: The doctor was in the kitchen. Half past ten. I'm quite certain of that.
clips.key: S4|steady|The doctor was in the kitchen. Half past ten. I'm quite certain of that.

clips.speaker: S1
clips.text: Pike was in the conservatory at half past ten. You'll have to ask him what he was doing.
clips.key: S1|steady|Pike was in the conservatory at half past ten. You'll have to ask him what he was doing.

clips.speaker: S4
clips.text: Half past ten? The candlestick was still in the lounge. It certainly drew the eye.
clips.key: S4|steady|Half past ten? The candlestick was still in the lounge. It certainly drew the eye.

clips.speaker: S1
clips.text: The letter knife? Still in the hall when it happened. It's an odd thing to remember, but I do.
clips.key: S1|steady|The letter knife? Still in the hall when it happened. It's an odd thing to remember, but I do.

clips.speaker: S3
clips.text: The medicine bottle was in the kitchen then. Please be precise about what you're suggesting.
clips.key: S3|steady|The medicine bottle was in the kitchen then. Please be precise about what you're suggesting.

clips.speaker: S2
clips.text: The bookend was still in the conservatory. At half past ten, if you insist on the time.
clips.key: S2|steady|The bookend was still in the conservatory. At half past ten, if you insist on the time.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A letter knife, laid out in the hall. Worth a closer look.
clips.key: NARRATOR|steady|A letter knife, laid out in the hall. Worth a closer look.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A brass candlestick in the lounge. Heavy enough to make me pause.
clips.key: NARRATOR|steady|A brass candlestick in the lounge. Heavy enough to make me pause.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.text: A marble bookend in the conservatory. Another possibility to account for.
clips.key: NARRATOR|steady|A marble bookend in the conservatory. Another possibility to account for.
